root_cause: Applied CRO/SEO changes had no operator view with old value, new value and difference, so improvements could not be judged or learned from.

actual_sources: public.social_experiments: 0 of 222 rows have pagina (read-only query, 2026-10-28)

fix: Read-only admin tab backed by a service_role read function; certainty is withheld below the minimum sample.
prevention_rule: A before/after value is only shown with its sample size; unknown is never rendered as zero and a small sample is never labelled proven.
terminal_rule: Not terminal until the migration is applied and the tab shows a first registered change in production.
